summary:
All 3 bug fixes verified end-to-end. Backend (5/5 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_strip_html_and_export.py): (1) Seeded scan doc with page markdown '# Rubrik Text
Mer text' -> GET /api/documents/{id}/markdown returns markdown without ' is clipped to a rounded viewport (styles.viewport with marginHorizontal:12, radius.lg, overflow:'hidden'), and a non-interactive A4 guide frame (width*1.414) with four corner marks + hint 'Placera sidan inom ramen' is overlaid via pointerEvents='none'. No full-screen SafeAreaView wraps the camera. The iOS Expo Router bundle (http://localhost:3000/node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=ios&dev=true&hot=false&lazy=true&transform.engine=hermes&transform.routerRoot=app) returns HTTP 200, confirming capture.tsx compiles and bundles cleanly for iOS. Real AI calls used in this iteration: 1 (within <=2 budget). Settings left untouched (speed_mode=fast, primary_provider=gemini).
critical_code_review_comments:
export.strip_html uses a single regex to remove the tag tokens for div/span/br/p/hr/center/font. The implementation is correct for the current bug but will NOT strip attribute-less self-closing XHTML like
on the FIRST pass only if the attribute regex happens to break — current pattern ']*>' handles '
' and '
' correctly (verified). No action.

server.run_process already wraps run_instruction output in strip_html before saving, so AI-emitted HTML is sanitized once at write-time. document_markdown ALSO re-strips at read-time (defense in depth) — this is good; the two guards are intentional and independent.

MarkdownView.tsx mirrors the backend tag list exactly (div|span|br|p|hr|center|font). If backend ever expands the list (e.g. 'table-of-contents' HTML markers), the frontend regex should be kept in sync — consider centralizing the pattern (e.g. shared constant exposed by /api/settings or hard-coded in both places with a code comment pointing to the other).

ai.INSTRUCTION_SYSTEM explicitly instructs 'no preamble, no title describing the task, no closing remarks, and NEVER any HTML tags'. Combined with strip_html at write time, the Word 'big descriptive title' bug and the page-break div bug are each defended at TWO layers (prompt + sanitization). Both verified above.

export.build_files calls pypandoc.convert_file WITHOUT any --metadata=title argument and without a YAML metadata block in the markdown — this is why 'Title' style no longer appears in word/document.xml. If anyone later adds --metadata=title=... or starts the markdown with '% Title' or front-matter, the big title at the top WILL reappear; worth a comment in export.py.
seed_data_creation: During the test run a scan course+document+page (markdown with page-break div) and a 'source' doc+page for /process were seeded via mongo pages collection and the FastAPI auth client; all were cleaned up in fixture teardown and via the final cleanup script. No test data remains in the test@copythat.app account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: test@copythat.app / 246810. The frontend web storage uses localStorage key 'copythat.token' with the token JSON-encoded (JSON.stringify) — raw strings cause a storage parse error. The pytest suite at test_strip_html_and_export.py performs ONE real AI call (/process); keep that in mind when running repeatedly to stay within AI budget. The capture screen (app/capture.tsx) is native-only (CameraView from expo-camera) and cannot be exercised in the web preview; its correctness was validated by static review + successful iOS bundle fetch. Current global settings remain speed_mode='fast', primary_provider='gemini'.
rca_of_issue: All three bugs reported by the user are now fully mitigated: (1) 'big descriptive title in Word export' — root cause was pandoc inferring a title from the first H1/metadata; fix is that build_files no longer passes --metadata=title and no title metadata appears in word/document.xml (verified 0 occurrences of w:val="Title"). (2) 'raw <div style=page-break-before> HTML visible in preview' — root cause was AI returning HTML page-break markers for section breaks; fix is a two-layer defense (ai.INSTRUCTION_SYSTEM forbids HTML; strip_html removes div/span/br/p/hr/center/font tags on save, read AND export; MarkdownView removes them in the preview as well — all three paths verified clean). (3) 'iPhone camera buttons under Dynamic Island / no guide frame' — root cause was the previous capture layout extending the camera full-screen with no safe-area top padding; fix (static review): top bar uses Math.max(insets.top, 54) on iOS, viewport is clipped between top and bottom bars, A4 guide frame with 4 corner marks + hint renders above the CameraView via pointerEvents=none; the iOS JS bundle builds successfully (HTTP 200 on expo-router entry.bundle).
